admission.mechanism: scoped helper variant /tmp/s4-helper-egress — crates/hh-helper/src/bin/hh_helper.rs verbatim plus the `network` knob (hharness-helper server/protocol and PodmanBackend unchanged); per-slot cells create with `podman --network bridge` (outbound NAT via the VM's slirp4netns) instead of `--network none`; the stock hh-helper binary and crate source are untouched
admission.policy: net.mode=public for admitted cells — the N4-honest declaration (kernel authority + a declared residual_channels[host_bridge] entry); fs/proc boundaries unchanged and still probed
admission.scope: only slots whose tasks declare runtime egress deps (mechanical scan of solution.* + run-tests.sh: apt/pip/uv bootstrap/git clone/curl|wget/HF/remote RPC); none stays for all others — in this supplement every rerun task declared deps
admission.selector: spec.egress_profile + spec.helper_bin per slot; recorded verbatim in every slot row
admission.first_attempt_semantics: these are named supplement attempts on the same frozen slots (same slot_ref/arm/lane/round; the frozen manifest is consumed verbatim, never re-picked). `first` still marks the manifest's round-0 subjects; `supplement_epoch` + `prior_disposition` mark the second-attempt fact verbatim — the original inconclusive records stand

declared_inputs.manifest: frozen central-protocol/1, seed parity-tranche-2026-11-05:seed:v3 (same manifest, verbatim)
declared_inputs.participant: per-task committed oracle solution — $0, no model calls
declared_inputs.subject_machinery: same HH machinery (EnvDriver/Dispatcher/compact/seal on hh-helper podman cells); the egress delta is the scoped helper variant only
declared_inputs.receipt: task's own verifier — run-tests.sh verbatim channel (now genuinely runnable: its uv/apt/pip bootstrap has egress), vendored_offline fallback unchanged; terminal-bench PytestParser

slots.disposition_recomputed: inconclusive{environment:cell_network_isolated:Connection refused} -> executed — the signature scan predates the egress profile: under declared_deps the cell is --network bridge and the 'Connection refused' was to localhost:5000 (the oracle's own flask service raced/not up inside the 360s work cap) — a genuine participant outcome, not cell isolation. receipt (verbatim channel, unresolved) retained verbatim.

verdict_basis: egress supplement over 140 prior-inconclusive slots: 90 executed with a real receipt (60 resolved / 30 unresolved); 50 still inconclusive, 0 failed, 0 unattempted; 18/28 supplement first-subject slots executed (12 resolved); 140 slots admitted egress_profile=declared_deps, 0 kept none.
